data.body:
LIVE EVIDENCE — the bug reproduced on this ticket's OWN fix (change 1691).

The currently-deployed review bot voted LLM-Review+1 on change 1691 with:

  [LLM-Review: PASS]
  rebar code review passed. 3 advisory finding(s) (non-blocking).

and GET /a/changes/1691/revisions/current/comments returns {} — no inline comments, no finding text anywhere on the change. Three advisory findings about the advisory-visibility fix itself are invisible to me, on the exact surface this ticket is about. This is a clean fourth reproduction alongside 1666, 1685 and 1636, on a change whose content I authored and can therefore reason about.

It also demonstrates the operator's stated cost directly: I cannot tell whether any of those 3 findings deserve promotion to blocking, or even whether they are about the new module, because the text is unreachable.

Once change 1691 lands and the bot is redeployed, the same review would render as:

  rebar code review passed. 3 advisory finding(s) (non-blocking):
  - (<criterion>) <finding text> [<path>:<line>]
  ...

plus an inline comment on each finding whose location resolves to a real path in the revision.
